name: @marktiderman/genesis-media
description: Images and files for Genesis apps: one image value (alt or decorative, size, focal point, phone crop, blur placeholder), responsive images (srcset, sizes, loading and priority) through a host's image URL builder, with Supabase Storage transform and pass-through adapters, byte sniffing, and a server-side fetch guarded against request forgery. Part of the Genesis framework.

doctor.reason: A library that sections and screens build on; a hand-written srcset or fetch guard isn't reliably detectable yet.

primitives.need: a responsive image, or fetching a URL a person gave on the server
primitives.use: responsiveImage with the host's image URL builder; fetchGuarded from /server
